protocol.purpose: Test whether omitted training-time action smoothing causes the repaired frozen GRU's value/continuation mismatch; not a new method
protocol.selection_evidence: Among completed single-factor continuation probes, no-smoothing reconciled31/71 old disagreements, versus deadline50=0 and no-filter=3. It also rescued16 and damaged13; it is not a deployable fix.
protocol.only_changed_factor: Apply the arm's velocity smoothing to every training action, including epsilon exploration. Candidate scoring and execution use identical smoothed velocities.

fixed.IL_initialization: research/recovery-duration/artifacts/gru-il.pth, identical for both arms; no IL retraining
fixed.training_filter: disabled in both arms, as in original training
fixed.optimizer: Adam1e-5, clipnorm10, original MC returns gamma.99
fixed.architecture_reward_actions_history: unchanged corrected GRU, native reward,80raw actions,T24 legal-prefix
fixed.terminal_scoring: Both arms use the same current public repair
fixed.fixed_root_test: Same164historical physical/history states and same original selected/forward executable first actions; evaluate each new critic and its own continuation, not old continuation returns

protocol.expected_mechanism: If training/deployment smoothing mismatch is a major acquisition cause, training with smoothing should reduce true-successor-versus-own-continuation ranking errors and actual timeouts without merely changing the test controller.
protocol.supported_threshold: At least20% fewer strict fixed-pair B/C misranks than matched control, at least4 fewer timeouts among240, and no extra independent-contact episodes; relate changed outcomes to observed smoothing-sensitive cases. This is a diagnostic threshold, not publication confirmation.
protocol.stop: One2000episode run per arm. No second factor, extension, sweep or retry for a negative scientific outcome. A negative result rejects sufficiency of this tested repair, not every possible effect of smoothing.
protocol.limits: One training seed; fresh post-repair matched control, not bitwise reproduction of historical optimizer/RNG state. Corrected terminal scoring shared. Historical IL demonstrations were unsmoothed and remain identical, so test targets only RL acquisition.
protocol.exploration_probe: Previously registered four paired draws/root continues independently; its result may not alter this frozen training factor. No further training follows.
